description: Every Tactical RMM endpoint as a typed command, plus an offline SQLite mirror and cross-entity fleet queries the web UI can't express.

auth_env_var_specs.name: TRMM_API_KEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: Tactical RMM API key (Settings > Global Settings > API Keys). Bypasses 2FA.

novel_features.name: Fleet health snapshot
novel_features.description: Whole-fleet posture in one command: online/offline/overdue agents, failing checks, pending reboots, outstanding patches, active alerts.

novel_features.name: Attention triage
novel_features.description: Ranked list of agents needing attention, scored across offline state, failing checks, reboots and patches.

novel_features.name: Stale-agent detection
novel_features.description: Agents whose last check-in exceeds a threshold, with client and site.

novel_features.name: Patch posture rollup
novel_features.description: Per-client/site rollup of pending Windows updates and reboots.

novel_features.name: Bulk remote run by filter
novel_features.description: Run a script/command across every agent matching a local-store filter (client/site/os/online).

novel_features.name: Check flapping detection
novel_features.description: Checks that repeatedly flipped pass/fail within a window, from local snapshots.

novel_features.name: Alert digest
novel_features.description: Grouped alert summary by client/severity/type over a time window.

novel_features.name: Fleet what-changed
novel_features.description: What changed across the fleet since a window: new alerts, newly-offline agents.

novel_features.name: Software / vulnerability sweep
novel_features.description: Which agents have a given software package installed across the fleet.

novel_features.name: Maintenance-mode sweep
novel_features.description: Put a filtered cohort of agents into maintenance mode in one command, with a reminder window (re-run with --clear to end it; Tactical RMM has no server-side expiry).

novel_features.name: Pending actions backlog
novel_features.description: Queued agent actions across the fleet grouped by agent and age, so stuck dispatches surface. Live fan-out: requires TRMM_API_KEY (agent list comes from the local store).

novel_features.name: Check-failure leaderboard
novel_features.description: Failing checks ranked by blast radius - how many agents are red on each check.

novel_features.name: Client posture scorecard
novel_features.description: One posture row per client: agent count, online share, failing checks, pending patches, open alerts.

novel_features.name: Service-down sweep
novel_features.description: Agents where a named Windows service is stopped, across the whole fleet. Live fan-out: requires TRMM_API_KEY (agent list comes from the local store).
